title: Single-Token Threshold Prevents Compounding
description: The compound threshold only checks ONE token (based on thresholdTokenIndex). If swap patterns naturally favor one direction, the other token accumulates while the threshold token stays below threshold. Compounding never triggers despite significant fees in the non-threshold token.
impact: Core auto-compound functionality fails under asymmetric market conditions
attackPath: Market conditions favor one-directional swaps (common in stablecoin pools)
Token1 fees accumulate heavily while Token0 stays below threshold
Compound threshold check always fails (only checks Token0)
Accumulated fees never compound, reducing capital efficiency
rootCause: Single-token threshold doesn't account for asymmetric fee accumulation
recommendation: Check threshold against both tokens, or use a combined USD-equivalent threshold
